notes.name: london-breakout.md
notes.summary: The note argues that a tight overnight range before the London open makes the open's expansion more likely, and that the expansion follows range compression rather than the news. It gives no out-of-sample check.
notes.hypothesis: We could test whether a tight overnight range predicts a larger London-open expansion than a wide one.

notes.name: funding-basis.md
notes.summary: Negative perpetual funding with a firm spot price is read as crowded shorts, not as a directional signal.
notes.hypothesis: We could test whether negative funding with a firm basis precedes a short squeeze.
